Container.Name: Faro
Container.Overview: Friendly, self-hosted DNS protection and network visibility. This template runs the same Faro application image used by standard Docker Compose.
Container.Description: Faro makes network-wide DNS protection approachable. It includes guided setup, device visibility, custom protection setups, curated blocklists, local DNS, activity explanations, encrypted backups, and upstream health monitoring. Give Faro a fixed address, then configure your router to distribute that address as the network DNS server.
Container.Requires: TCP and UDP port 53 must be available. A dedicated static IP on an Unraid custom ipvlan or macvlan network is recommended when the host already uses port 53.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Faro's database, generated DNS configuration, cached icons, and bounded raw query logs.

Config.Name: Web Interface
Config.Description: Faro web interface port. Change the host port when using bridge networking; custom-IP installations use Faro's internal port 1787.

Config.Name: DNS (UDP)
Config.Description: DNS service over UDP. Keep this at port 53 for router-wide DNS.

Config.Name: DNS (TCP)
Config.Description: DNS service over TCP. Use the same host port as UDP.

Config.Name: Query Log Size
Config.Description: Maximum size in bytes of each raw CoreDNS query-log file.

Config.Name: Query Log Backups
Config.Description: Number of rotated raw DNS query-log files retained.
